ValidationRule.description: This validation rule prevents user to select customer account for dealer case and dealer account for All Cases
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR( ISPICKVAL( Country__c , 'United Kingdom'), ISPICKVAL( Country__c , 'Ireland')), OR(AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'VFS_Dealer', Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Account'), AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'All_Case', Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Dealer_Account')))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select Customer Account for All Cases and Dealer Account for Dealer Case
